name: Michael Franti
description: '''Michael Franti''' (born April 21, 1966) is an American singer, songwriter, musician, poet, activist, documentarian, and rapper — widely known for his numerous musical projects with political and social emphasis, including [[the Beatnigs]] and [[the Disposable Heroes of Hiphoprisy]]. Franti founded and is lead vocalist of '''Michael Franti & Spearhead''', a band blending [[hip-hop]] with a variety of other styles including [[funk]], [[reggae]], [[jazz]], [[Contemporary folk music|folk]], and [[rock music|rock]]. He is outspoken on [[peace movement|peace]] and [[social justice]] and [[Middle East]] issues.
